description: Compare two pages now (mode=pages) or measure one page against its locally stored baseline (mode=baseline). Baseline mode records the first call; use runs=3 or more and rely on guaranteed deltas, not medians alone. Example: compare staging against production, or verify whether a deployed fix improved mobile LCP. replaceBaseline overwrites local baseline state.

mode.description: pages compares url and against; baseline compares url to its saved measurement.

replaceBaseline.description: Only baseline mode: overwrite the local stored baseline.

responseFormat.description: markdown is concise and readable; json is machine-readable and is also available as structuredContent.

runs.description: Use 2–5 for baseline mode; 3 is recommended.

strategy.description: Device profile; part of baseline identity.

url.description: Public http(s) URL, for example https://example.com/products.

name: pagespeed_compare_pages
title: Compare Pages or a Stored Baseline
